title.value: Relating to prohibitions for certain products; creating new provisions; and amending ORS 459.995.
title.provenance: A BILL FOR AN ACT Relating to prohibitions for certain products; creating new provisions; and amending ORS 459.995.

pfas_definition.provenance: “Perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substance” means a substance included in a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: SECTION 4. A person may not sell, offer for sale, or distribute in or into this state a foodware container containing perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substances.

date.provenance: (1) Sections 1 to 4 of this 2023 Act and the amendments to ORS 459.995 by section 8 of this 2023 Act become operative on January 1, 2025.
